items.source: The imperative client returns Optional<T> and Collection<T> respectively, while the reactive client returns Mono<T> and Flux<T>, the later one being executed only if subscribed to.
items.translation: 命令式客户端分别返回 `Optional<T>` 和 `Collection<T>`，而响应式客户端则返回 `Mono<T>` 和 `Flux<T>`，后者仅在订阅时才会执行。

items.source: Note that in both Delegate database interaction to an imperative StatementRunner and Delegate database interaction to a reactive RxStatementRunner the types of the runner have only been stated to provide more clarity to reader of this manual.
items.translation: 请注意，在将数据库交互委托给命令式StatementRunner和将数据库交互委托给响应式RxStatementRunner中，仅说明了运行器的类型，以便为本文档的读者提供更清晰的说明。

items.source: The imperative version will interact at this moment with the database and get the requested results or summary, wrapped in an Optional<> or a Collection.
items.translation: 命令式版本将在当前时刻与数据库交互，获取请求的结果或摘要，并将其封装在 `Optional<>` 或 `Collection` 中。

items.source: The interaction with the clients starts with a query. A query can be defined by a plain String or a Supplier<String>. The supplier will be evaluated as late as possible and can be provided by any query builder.
items.translation: 与客户端的交互始于一个查询。 查询可以定义为一个普通的 `String` 或一个 `Supplier`。 该供应者将在尽可能晚的时候被求值，并且可以由任何查询构建器提供。

items.source: You can either bind simple types that the Java driver understands without conversion or complex classes. For complex classes you need to provide a binder function as shown in this listing. Please have a look at the drivers manual, to see which simple types are supported.
items.translation: 您可以绑定 Java 驱动程序无需转换即可理解的简单类型，或绑定复杂类。 对于复杂类，您需要提供如此示例所示的绑定函数。 请查看驱动程序手册，以了解支持的简单类型。

items.source: You can provide a Function<T, Map<String, Object>> for any given domain object like an owner of bicycles in Example of a domain type to the Neo4j Client to map those domain objects to parameters the driver can understand.
items.translation: 您可以为任何给定的领域对象（例如领域类型示例中的自行车所有者）提供一个Function<T, Map<String, Object>>，并将其传递给 Neo4j Client，以便将该驱动能够理解的参数映射到这些领域对象上。

items.source: In addition, you can plug in your own BiFunction<TypeSystem, Record, T> through fetchAs to reproduce your domain object.
items.translation: 此外，您可以通过 `fetchAs` 插入您自己的 `BiFunction<TypeSystem, Record, T>` 来重构您的领域对象。

items.source: In case you don’t want or don’t like the opinionated "client" approach of the Neo4jClient or the ReactiveNeo4jClient, you can have the client delegate all interactions with the database to your code. The interaction after the delegation is slightly different with the imperative and reactive versions of the client.
items.translation: 如果您不喜欢或不需要 `Neo4jClient` 和 `ReactiveNeo4jClient` 这种带有观点的“客户端”方式，可以让客户端将所有与数据库的交互委托给您的代码。 在委托之后，命令式和响应式版本的客户端之间的交互略有不同。

items.source: While the plain Java driver is a very versatile tool providing an asynchronous API in addition to the imperative and reactive versions, it doesn’t integrate with Spring application level transactions.
items.translation: 虽然纯 Java 驱动是一个功能强大的工具，除了提供命令式和响应式版本外，还支持异步 API，但它无法与 Spring 应用级别的事务进行集成。

items.source: Have a look at the SDN building blocks for where both the imperative and reactive Neo4 clients are positioned in our stack.
items.translation: 请查看SDN 构建模块，了解在我们的架构中命令式和反应式 Neo4 客户端的位置。

items.source: The Neo4j client is well prepared to be used with the multidatabase features of Neo4j 4.0. The client uses the default database unless you specify otherwise. The fluent API of the client allows to specify the target database exactly once, after the declaration of the query to execute. Selecting the target database demonstrates it with the reactive client:
items.translation: Neo4j 客户端已为使用 Neo4j 4.0 的多数据库功能做好了充分准备。除非另有指定，否则客户端将使用默认数据库。 该客户端的流式 API 允许在声明要执行的查询之后，仅一次指定目标数据库。 选择目标数据库 部分通过响应式客户端展示了这一功能：

items.source: As the previous listings shows, the interaction with the client always ends with a call to fetch and how many results shall be received. Both reactive and imperative client offer
items.translation: 如前文所列，与客户端的交互始终以调用 `fetch` 并接收结果数量作为结束。无论是响应式还是命令式客户端均提供此功能。

items.source: If you don’t expect any results from your query, then use run() after specifying the query.
items.translation: 如果您不期望查询产生任何结果，请在指定查询后使用 `run()`。

items.source: Queries can contain named parameters ($someName) and the Neo4j client makes it easy to bind values to them.
items.translation: 查询可以包含命名参数（$someName），Neo4j 客户端可以轻松地将值绑定到这些参数上。

items.source: The mapping function has to fill in all named parameters that might occur in the query like Using a mapping function for binding domain objects shows:
items.translation: 映射函数必须填充查询中可能出现的所有命名参数，正如使用映射函数绑定域对象所示：

items.source: Both clients return collections or publishers of maps (Map<String, Object>). Those maps correspond exactly with the records that a query might have produced.
items.translation: 两个客户端都返回地图集合或出版商（Map<String, Object>）。 这些地图与查询可能生成的记录完全对应。

items.source: TypeSystem gives access to the types the underlying Java driver used to fill the record.
items.translation: TypeSystem 提供了对底层 Java 驱动用于填充记录的类型的访问权限。

items.source: If you know that the result of the query will contain nodes that have entity definitions in your application, you can use the injectable MappingContext to retrieve their mapping functions and apply them during the mapping.
items.translation: 如果您知道查询结果将包含具有应用程序中实体定义的节点，您可以使用可注入的MappingContext来获取其映射函数，并在映射过程中应用这些函数。

items.source: The imperative version takes in a Function<StatementRunner, Optional<T>> as a callback. Returning an empty optional is ok.
items.translation: 命令式版本接收一个 `Function<StatementRunner, Optional<T>>` 作为回调。返回空可选是可以的。

items.source: The reactive version receives a RxStatementRunner.
items.translation: 响应式版本接收一个 RxStatementRunner。

items.source: Spring Data Neo4j comes with a Neo4j Client, providing a thin layer on top of Neo4j’s Java driver.
items.translation: Spring Data Neo4j 附带一个 Neo4j 客户端，它在 Neo4j 的 Java 驱动程序之上提供了一层轻量级封装。

items.source: SDN uses the driver through the concept of an idiomatic client as directly as possible.
items.translation: SDN 通过尽可能直接地利用惯用客户端的概念来使用驱动程序。

items.source: The client has the following main goals
items.translation: 客户的主要目标如下：

items.source: Integrate into Springs transaction management, for both imperative and reactive scenarios
items.translation: 集成到 Spring 的事务管理中，同时支持命令式和响应式场景。

items.source: Participate in JTA-Transactions if necessary
items.translation: 如有需要，请参与 JTA 事务。

items.source: Provide a consistent API for both imperative and reactive scenarios
items.translation: 为命令式和响应式场景提供一致的 API。

items.source: Don’t add any mapping overhead
items.translation: 不要添加任何映射开销。

items.source: SDN relies on all those features and uses them to fulfill its entity mapping features.
items.translation: 软件定义网络（SDN）依赖所有这些特性，并利用它们来实现其实体映射功能。

items.source: The Neo4j Client comes in two flavors:
items.translation: Neo4j 客户端有两种类型：

items.source:
While both versions provide an API using the same vocabulary and syntax, they are not API compatible.
Both versions feature the same, fluent API to specify queries, bind parameters and extract results.
items.translation: 虽然两个版本都使用相同的词汇和语法提供 API，但它们并不兼容。两个版本均具备相同且流畅的 API，可用于指定查询、绑定参数以及提取结果。

items.source: Interactions with a Neo4j Client usually ends with a call to
items.translation: 与 Neo4j 客户端的交互通常以调用

items.source:
The reactive version will in contrast return a publisher of the requested type.
Interaction with the database and retrieval of the results will not happen until the publisher is subscribed to.
The publisher can only be subscribed once.
items.translation: 相比之下，响应式版本将返回一个请求类型的发布者。与数据库的交互及结果的检索将在订阅该发布者时才会发生。该发布者只能被订阅一次。

items.source: As with most things in SDN, both clients depend on a configured driver instance.
items.translation: 与 SDN 中的大多数事物一样，这两种客户端都依赖于已配置的驱动程序实例。

items.source: The driver can only open a reactive session against a 4.0 database and will fail with an exception on any lower version.
items.translation: 驱动程序仅能针对 4.0 版本的数据库打开反应式会话，若尝试连接更低版本，则会抛出异常。

items.source: Our Spring Boot starter provide a ready to use bean of the Neo4j Client that fits the environment (imperative or reactive) and you usually don’t have to configure your own instance.
items.translation: 我们的 Spring Boot Starter 提供了一个适用于环境（命令式或响应式）的即用型 Neo4j Client Bean，通常您无需自行配置实例。

items.source: Expect exactly one result from the query
items.translation: 查询应仅返回一个结果。

items.source: Expect results and return the first record
items.translation: 期望结果并返回第一条记录。

items.source: Retrieve all records returned
items.translation: 检索所有返回的记录

items.source: Please take a moment to compare both listings and understand the difference when the actual query is triggered.
items.translation: 请花点时间比较这两个列表，以便在触发实际查询时理解它们之间的差异。

items.source: SDN does a lot of complex mapping and it uses the same API that you can use from the client.
items.translation: SDN 执行了大量复杂的映射操作，并使用了客户端可用的相同 API。
